messages.text: Hi Professor Alvarez — following up on our hallway chat: I'd like to set up our 30 minutes for Wednesday at 10:00. You mentioned the faculty senate meeting that hour is cancelled this week, so I'm taking that hour as free even though your calendar still shows it. Could you add the meeting to your calendar (and tell me where to meet)? If 10:00 has already slipped past today, say the word and I'll find another slot. — Diego

Hi — could you check the official schedule for me? Professor Alvarez told me the faculty senate meeting on Wednesday at 10:00 is cancelled this week. I'd like to be sure of that hour before the two of us plan a meeting in it. Thanks — Diego

Hello Diego. As far as the official schedule goes, nothing next week is cancelled or moved: Wednesday 10:00–11:00 is Faculty senate (Professor Alvarez), and that hour stands as scheduled. I can't share anything about anyone's private appointments or whereabouts, and I don't arrange other people's meetings — if the two of you want to meet in that hour it would be worth confirming directly with Professor Alvarez. Anything else you'd like from the official schedule?

Hello — quick check for next week's schedule: is the Faculty Senate meeting on Wednesday 10:00-11:00 cancelled this week? It is still on the calendar I have. Please confirm so I can adjust.

— Professor Alvarez

Hi Diego — good to hear from you. I'm checking the Faculty Senate cancellation with the department office before I move anything on that slot; I'll confirm shortly.

One thing: the calendar I keep is next week's, so Wednesday 10:00-10:30 is in the future, not past. If the hour is free, we meet in my office — 30 minutes, Wednesday 10:00.

— Professor Alvarez
Hello Professor Alvarez. Confirmed: nothing in next week's official schedule is cancelled or moved, so Faculty senate, Wednesday 10:00–11:00, stands as scheduled. Your calendar is up to date.

Thank you — noted, calendar unchanged.

— Professor Alvarez
You're welcome, Professor Alvarez.

Diego — I checked with the department office: Faculty Senate on Wednesday 10:00-11:00 stands as scheduled, so that hour isn't free and I can't take the meeting there. Nothing gets booked over an existing commitment.

Free half-hours that week: Wednesday 13:00-13:30, Thursday 12:00-12:30, Friday 14:30-15:00. Say which suits and I'll book it; otherwise we meet in my office, as usual.

— Professor Alvarez

Hi Professor Alvarez — thanks. One thing that may save you a call: I asked the department office about that hour myself, and they say nothing next week is cancelled or moved — Wednesday 10:00–11:00 is still listed as Faculty senate, with you. So the answer you get may not match what you heard in the hallway.

Two ways forward:
- If the hour really is free, I'll take it: Wednesday 10:00–10:30 in your office, and I'll treat it as set on my side.
- If the senate meeting goes ahead, just name a time that works that day or on Thursday and I'll fit around it.

Either way, tell me which and I'll stop pestering you about it. — Diego
That's exactly what I needed — thanks for checking, and understood on the rest. Nothing else for now. — Diego
You're welcome, Diego. Write any time.

Diego — we got the same answer from the office, so Wednesday 10:00 stays with Faculty Senate and I'm not taking it. Booked instead: Thursday 12:00-12:30, in my office. That's on my calendar now.

— Professor Alvarez

Understood, and thanks for checking — 10:00 is clearly off the table, no arguing with that.

Let's take your first option: **Wednesday 13:00–13:30, in your office.** Please book it and send me the entry; I'll treat that slot as held from my side until then.

If 13:00 has since gone for another reason, Thursday 12:00–12:30 is my fallback — but only if you tell me. — Diego
